name: Tulgah
description: The Tulgahs were a sentient species of short beings with squat, humanoid frames and yellow skin. Tulgah were inherently magical. Different Tulgah put their abilities to different uses. For example, some became great healers, while others turned to evil pursuits.

data.name: Tulgah
data.origin: Homeworld unknown; colonies on Endor and Kashyyyk
